director_question: Is this prospective, no-update two-checkpoint ranking/margin study scientifically valid to launch, or what is the smallest change needed?
question: Did FAMILY_BALANCED improve local correct target-token ranks or margins versus V7 despite lower frozen Greedy exact-grid accuracy?
frozen_conditions: B32 primary plus fixed target-blind B1 sensitivity subset
no generation, update, candidate selection, Gold, dGold, or FINAL_AUDIT
grid content, separators, and EOS measured separately
equal-family macro primary; pooled token micro secondary
decision_rules: robust positive critical-token effects with lower exact grid suggests sequence accumulation/exposure limitation
nonpositive or inconclusive critical-token effects means prior NLL changes did not promote critical decisions
family-specific protected harm aligned with rank harm requires preservation in successors
identity, round-trip, partial-evidence, or B32/B1 material drift means INCONCLUSIVE
